title: Double Drip Pineapple Ice Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Pineapple Ice Nic Salt delivers the tropical taste of sweet, tangy Pineapple layered with a crisp, cool Menthol finish. The fruity notes bring a bright, juicy, sun-soaked flavour with just the right touch of rich, tangy tartness, while the brisk, icy exhale keeps the experience fresh and clean from the first puff to the last. Formulated with nicotine salts for fast-acting nicotine satisfaction and a smooth, comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for excellent flavour clarity and reliable MTL performance. It’s ideal for use with lower-powered vape kits such as refillable pod systems , vape pens , and compact starter devices . Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
